causal_graphs.family_mapping: E. coli K-12 YecE P37348, sequence version 4, equals NP_416382.1, AAC74938.1 and BAA15679.2; 272 aa with PF01904 at 3-258. b1868/JW1857 reference identity is not independent sequencing of the historical assay clone.
causal_graphs.limitations: Normalized double-mutant colony growth is compared with multiplicative expected fitness from the single mutants, not WT or the addition of one deletion. Positive scores are not WT rescue or faster absolute growth. All 21 donors are non-essential and labeled This Study in Table S1; Table S16 verifies their Hfr Cavalli deletion::Cm context. Raw colony images, row-specific dispersion, exact clone sequences and allele-specific rescue were not inspected. Marker, polar and secondary-mutation effects remain alternatives; no gene-to-gene molecular pathway is inferred.

causal_graphs.title: YecE joint deletions alter colony growth relative to multiplicative expectations

causal_graphs.context: Joint modeled Tm1631, DNA, two Mg ions and an assumed nucleophile; a 42-atom QM region treated with B3LYP/6-31G* within CHARMM36. Sixteen interpolated replicas connect constructed reactant/product endpoints.

evidence.explanation: Visually inspected original Figures 1-3, main Methods and parsed supplemental captions/coordinate subsets support the authors' computational proposal only. Figure S2 explicitly resolves model Lys73 as native K72; no K73 mutant or measured proton-transfer event.

edges.mechanism: The proposed path places a nucleophile near the DNA phosphate and produces a pentacovalent state; replica 5 is a modeled potential-energy minimum, not an experimentally trapped intermediate. An early lysine-deprotonation event was not established and is not added as a separate edge.
edges.subject: modeled-reactant-system

evidence.explanation: Original Figures 1-3 and Methods describe the proposed path to the constructed cleaved-DNA endpoint. Figures 4/5 retain distinct ion and environment comparisons; their profiles are not adopted as kinetic rate enhancements.

edges.mechanism: Under the same joint modeled conditions, the proposed phosphate intermediate proceeds to P-O3' bond cleavage. Constructed product endpoints and relative potential energies do not establish real turnover, product release, cleavage specificity or an independent experimental observation.
edges.subject: proposed-pentacovalent-state

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Thermotoga maritima MSB8 Tm1631 Q9X1W6, sequence version 1, equals AAD36698.1 and WP_004082107.1; 261 aa, PF01904 at 3-259. PDB 1VPQ entity residues 13-273 match this sequence after a 12-residue tag. Supplement Figure S2 maps modeled Lys73 to native K72; reference residue 73 is T.
causal_graphs.limitations: PDB 1VPQ contains sulfate and water, not observed bound DNA or Mg. The starting pose and chemistry are constructed; 2013 restraints, initial neutral lysine, hydroxide generation and ion identity/count remain assumptions. Relative potential-energy profiles are not measured rates or fully sampled activation free energies. Figures 4/5 change ion or wider-environment conditions, not an isolated protein-only deletion. Five coordinate subsets were parsed, not rerun as QM calculations. No demonstrated DNA binding, residue-mutant effect, biological repair or family-wide nuclease activity.

evidence.explanation: Binding-site similarity, restrained molecular dynamics and an entropy-qualified MM/GBSA comparison generate a candidate pose; beta-clamp association is motif based, not measured.
Main figures and supplemental caption resolve the proposed path and model Lys73/native K72 mapping. Initial protonation and ion chemistry remain assumptions, not experimentally tested steps.

discussions.notes: Seek independently verified DNA binding, product identity, metal dependence, substrate specificity and residue perturbations with folding/abundance controls. Keep modeled/native numbering explicit. Supplementary DOC text/tables were parsed but images were dropped by conversion, so their plots were not visually checked. No simulation was rerun.
discussions.prompt: Test the proposed Tm1631 chemistry without treating simulation as experimental characterization.
discussions.rationale: Two computational steps preserve the proposed reaction but do not establish nuclease activity. The 2016 work extends the 2013 model rather than independently replicating an experiment.

evidence.explanation: All exact YecE recipient rows were retained with scores and donor identities; linkage filtering and repeated colony measurements do not remove every marker, polar or secondary-mutation alternative.
Reference YecE maps PF01904 at 3-258; reference equality does not independently sequence each historical assay clone.

discussions.notes: Examine raw fitness data, independent alleles, complementation and exact Hfr/Keio-derived clone identity. Positive interactions are not WT rescue. YunF expression, cofitness, prophage insertion at the yecE locus and similarly named unrelated enzymes remain excluded leads. Most of the 14646 frozen members and other structures remain unassessed. Keep IN_PROGRESS; this is partial same-agent curation.
discussions.prompt: Independently validate YecE joint-genotype phenotypes and extend member-specific coverage.
discussions.rationale: Twenty-one observed indirect growth effects preserve a multiplicative single-mutant baseline, not a molecular interaction network or general DUF72 DNA-repair mechanism.
